# Codex ZCode Tandem

> A Windows Codex skill that coordinates native ZCode over ACP. Codex scopes and reviews the work; ZCode implements, tests, or reviews with the user's own Coding Plan.

Independent community project. Public skill name: codex-zcode-tandem.
Supported baseline: Windows, Node 24.19.0, zcode-acp-server 0.65.1, ZCode Desktop 3.14.4.7912 / CLI 0.16.9.
Models: GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash, default thought=max.
License: MIT for this project's code and documentation; upstream products retain their own terms.

Queued steering is not mid-tool injection; tool controls are not an OS sandbox; completion is not business acceptance. This index is a reading aid, not an authorization grant or a search-ranking guarantee.
